title: Traditional Chinese herbal tea Psychotria rubra suppresses inflammatory response caused by respiratory tract infections via STAT3/IL-6/TNF.
authors: Li, Wenlan; Zhang, Zijie; Jiang, Zixiao; Barasarathi, Jayanthi; Zhou, Ying; Liu, Sui; Lee, Shiou Yih; Liu, Yangyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究草药Psychotria rubra通过STAT3/IL-6/TNF通路抗炎，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Psychotria rubra Herbal Tea (PRHT) is a traditional Chinese folk medicine used to treat in-flammation induced by respiratory infections. Its specific mechanisms of action, however, remain unclear. The study combined ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-Q-TOF-MS), network pharmacology, and in vitro cell experiments to systematically analyze the chemical composition and validate the biological activity of PRHT. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis and molecular docking were used to identify key targets and mechanisms. PRHT was found to contain 128 active compounds, including alkaloids, amino acids and their derivatives, and flavonoids. Key targets such as STAT3, IL-6, and TP53 were identified through PPI network analysis. PRHT exhibited significant anti-inflammatory effects by modulating the STAT3/IL-6/TNF-alpha signaling pathway. Experimental results demonstrated that PRHT inhibited the release of inflammatory cytokines in a dose-dependent manner. Molecular docking confirmed strong interactions between PRHT components and core targets. The study reveals that PRHT exerts anti-inflammatory effects by regulating the STAT3/IL-6/TNF-alpha signaling pathway, contributing to inflammation balance and tis-sue repair. These findings provide scientific evidence for the development of PRHT as a functional anti-inflammatory agent and offer new insights into treatment strategies for respiratory infections.
abstract_zh: Psychotria rubra Herbal Tea (PRHT) 是一种传统中药民间药物，用于治疗由呼吸道感染引起的炎症。然而，其具体作用机制尚不清楚。本研究结合超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱 (UPLC-Q-TOF-MS)、网络药理学和体外细胞实验，系统分析了PRHT的化学成分并验证其生物活性。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 网络分析和分子对接，确定了关键靶点和机制。研究发现PRHT含有128种活性化合物，包括生物碱、氨基酸及其衍生物和黄酮类化合物。通过PPI网络分析，识别出STAT3、IL-6和TP53等关键靶点。PRHT通过调节STAT3/IL-6/TNF-alpha信号通路表现出显著的抗炎作用。实验结果表明，PRHT以剂量依赖性方式抑制炎症细胞因子的释放。分子对接证实了PRHT成分与核心靶点之间的强相互作用。本研究揭示，PRHT通过调节STAT3/IL-6/TNF-alpha信号通路发挥抗炎作用，有助于炎症平衡和组织修复。这些发现为开发PRHT作为功能性抗炎剂提供了科学依据，并为呼吸道感染的治疗策略提供了新见解。
